title: 第13章 混沌神魔观想法，被道德绑架了？
content_zh:
君家，天帝宫内。
君逍遥盘坐在一处修炼密室内。
周围堆满了诸多绝品神源，释放无穷无尽的浓郁灵气。
在仙域，一般武者乃是用普通源石修炼。
而一些顶级道统，一流势力的修士，则会用更加珍贵的天源修炼。
只有如荒古世家，无上道统，不朽皇朝等势力，才用得起最珍贵的神源。
而在神源之上，还有仙源，不过那种东西，可遇不可求，一般荒古世家都拿不出多少。
不同稀有度的源石，都有下，中，上，绝，四个品级。
君逍遥修炼用的，就是除仙源之外，最为顶级的绝品神源。
可以说，君逍遥随便拿出一枚绝品神源，放到外界都会让一批人抢破头颅。
此刻，君逍遥闭目盘坐。
他的脑海之中，有着一座璀璨恢弘的宫殿。
这正是由灵魂力凝聚出的神宫。
肉身五境，神藏五境，都是将肉体修炼到极致。
灵海九重天，是修炼丹田灵海，关乎法力雄浑程度。
而神宫九重天，则是修炼神宫，让灵魂茁壮。
等到君逍遥突破到真灵境。
神宫之内，便会孕育出一尊真灵，那时候他的灵魂力将会再度暴涨。
日后甚至可将真灵化为元神，脱离肉身，遨游四海八荒。
“这混沌神磨观想法，果然不俗……”君逍遥心里暗想。

他脑海之中，仿佛衍生出了一片混沌世界。
混沌之中，一口巨大无边的神磨，缓缓转动，碾压天地。
神磨之上，沾染着斑斑血迹，好似神魔之血一般。
这混沌神磨观想法，正是依靠观想神磨，碾碎人的意识灵魂，然后再度重塑。
君逍遥的灵魂，就在这般毁灭与重生当中，越发凝实茁壮。
“换做一般人修炼这法门，绝对会被折磨的生不如死，但对我而言，好像不是太过困难。”君逍遥想道。
或许是因为他是穿越过来的灵魂，所以灵魂力远胜常人。
这混沌神磨对他帮助很大，却不会带来痛苦。
“而且之后随着修炼深入，更是可以直接用灵魂力衍化出混沌神磨，当做对敌手段。”
“那种痛苦，我可以忍受，其他人想必忍受不了。”君逍遥啧啧叹道。
他貌似又多了一手强悍底牌。
与此同时，皇州上空。
一头火灵雀，拉着一座华丽的辇车，振翅飞过虚空，带出一道绚烂的尾焰。
这吸引力许多人的注意。
“咦，那座辇车有朱雀图腾，好像是朱雀古国的辇车？”
“没错，传闻朱雀古国皇族之人，以火灵雀拉车，莫非是那位美名远扬的皇女，拜玉儿？”
“看其前往的方向，是君家！”
这驾辇车的到来，让诸多人议论。
不过多时，车辇停在了君家驻地外。
整个君家上空，除了君家自己人外，其余势力之人，胆敢贸然横空而过，都会被视作入侵，直接抹杀。

辇车门帘挑开，一位身姿高挑，双腿修长，穿着红色羽衣的美丽女子迈腿而出，正是拜玉儿。
她此次乃是孤身一人前来，并未携带随从。
拜玉儿放眼望去，君家驻地内，无数神岛悬浮虚空，各种洞天福地，喷吐霞光。
这让拜玉儿心头震撼。
朱雀古国虽然也是一流势力，声名远扬，但同荒古世家君家相比，依然是小巫见大巫，没有太多的可比性。
但随即，拜玉儿嘴角便是挑起了一抹自信和淡淡的不屑。
君家再超然又怎样？
那位君家的天骄人物，还不是馋她的身子，要将不死药送给她。
不过拜玉儿已经打定主意，不会轻易将身子交给那位君家天骄。
毕竟她可是有婚约在身。
到时候闹出点什么事情，岂不是让青龙古国大皇子头上一片绿油油？
想好之后，拜玉儿走上前去。
君家门口有君家禁卫把守，如铁塔一般巍峨，气血滔天。
“来者止步，报上名来。”
君家禁卫语气冷漠道。
“我乃朱雀古国皇女，拜玉儿，前来拜见君玲珑。”拜玉儿语气淡淡道。
“拜见贵女？可有信物，没有的话就滚。”君家禁卫淡漠道。
拜玉儿娇颜一滞。
她好歹也是一国皇女，连君家一个门卫都敢这么呵斥她。
不过她这次前来有所求，只能耐着性子，拿出了和君玲珑通讯的玉简。

“进去吧。”君家禁卫淡漠地挥了挥手。
拜玉儿咬唇，她皇女的身份，在君家面前，竟显得如此不值一提。
而另一边，君玲珑也是找到了君逍遥。
“神子大人，她已经来了。”君玲珑说道。
“走吧，去看看这位皇女。”
君逍遥起身，一袭白衫，神秀俊逸，虽只有八岁，但身材欣长如少年。
这边，拜玉儿走到了一处如仙境般的庭院内。
君玲珑和她约在这里相见。
不过多时，拜玉儿听到了脚步声，一眼看去。
但见一位身材欣长，浑身肌肤如仙玉一般的少年，缓慢踱步而来。
他仿佛如神祇之子，神姿玉骨，俊颜绝世，周身笼罩着一层薄薄光辉。
拜玉儿都是看呆了。
她见过的天之骄子，年轻俊杰也并不在少数，各个英俊风流。
但同面前这少年相比，却是如萤火与皓月，泥鳅与真龙，根本没有可比性。
甚至于她的那位未婚夫，青龙古国大皇子，也是清秀俊逸，天赋超凡，但和面前的少年相比，依然显得黯淡无光。
在君逍遥身旁，一身宫装的君玲珑，慢半拍跟在他脚后。
拜玉儿看到这个细节，更是心底深吸了一口气。
君玲珑可是君家贵女，是她都要讨好巴结的存在，结果现在，怎么感觉变成了随从丫鬟？
“这位君家天骄，究竟是何来历，莫非是一位序列？”拜玉儿心头掀起骇浪。
“你就是拜玉儿？”君逍遥淡淡问道。

“正是。”拜玉儿微微行了一礼，不过很是矜持。
她也回过神来了。
面前少年再超然又如何，还不是对她有所图谋。
既然如此，她也没必要太过卑微，自降身价。
“你想要求一株不死药，救你的父亲？”君逍遥继续道。
“没错，希望公子发发善心，能够伸出援手。”拜玉儿从容道，语气没有丝毫谦卑之意。
君逍遥看到这一幕，微微挑眉。
怎么感觉这态度……
不太对啊。
好像她根本不是来求药，而是理所当然的前来索取。
“哦？不过你能给我一个理由吗，毕竟不死药也不是从天上掉下来的。”君逍遥语气淡淡，说道。
拜玉儿玉颜微微一滞，而后嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的讥嘲。
果然，是带着目的的吗？
不过拜玉儿自是不可能以自己为条件，去交换不死药。
她开口道：“公子是非凡人，想必在君家地位不俗，应该不缺不死药，而公子献出一株不死药，则能够挽救一条生命。”
“不但如此，救我父皇，就是救了整个朱雀古国亿万子民的性命。”
“这对公子而言，不过举手之劳，却能收获功德与美名，难道公子都不愿意做吗？”
拜玉儿开口，立在道德的制高点上。
君逍遥有能力救济，为什么不救济？
能力越大，责任越大，难道不是吗？

听到这有些熟悉的言论，君逍遥反倒有些想笑。
“原来我也有被道德绑架的一天？”君逍遥心里顿生无语。
content_en:
Jun's house, inside the Emperor's Palace.
Jun Xiaoyao was sitting cross-legged in a secret cultivation room.
The surroundings are filled with many top-quality divine sources, releasing endless rich spiritual energy.
In the Immortal Realm, ordinary warriors use ordinary source stones to practice.
And some top cultivators and monks from first-class forces will use the more precious Tianyuan to practice.
Only forces such as the Ancient Family, the Supreme Taoist Lineage, and the Immortal Dynasty can afford the most precious divine source.
On top of the Divine Source, there is also the Immortal Source, but that kind of thing is hard to come by, and most ancient families cannot afford much of it.
Source stones of different rarities have four grades: low, medium, high, and absolute.
What Jun Xiaoyao uses for his cultivation is the most top-notch divine source besides the Immortal Source.
It can be said that if Jun Xiaoyao casually takes out a top-grade divine source and puts it to the outside world, a group of people will kill it.
At this moment, Jun Xiaoyao sat cross-legged with his eyes closed.
In his mind, there is a splendid and magnificent palace.
This is the palace condensed by soul power.
The five realms of the physical body and the five realms of the divine treasure are all about cultivating the physical body to the extreme.
The ninth level of the spiritual sea is the cultivation of the spiritual sea in the Dantian, which is related to the strength of the magic power.
The ninth level of the Divine Palace is to cultivate the Divine Palace and let the soul grow strong.
Wait until Jun Xiaoyao breaks through to the true spirit realm.
Within the palace, a true spirit will be born, and at that time his soul power will skyrocket again.
In the future, the true spirit can even be transformed into a spirit, leaving the physical body and traveling around the world.
"This Chaos God's idea of ​​grinding is really good..." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
A chaotic world seemed to have emerged in his mind.
In the chaos, a huge and boundless divine mill slowly rotated, crushing the heaven and earth.
The divine mill was stained with blood, as if it were the blood of gods and demons.
This concept of the Chaos God Mill relies on the visualization of the God Mill to crush the human consciousness and soul, and then reshape it again.
Jun Xiaoyao's soul became stronger and stronger amid such destruction and rebirth.
"For ordinary people to practice this method, they will definitely be tortured to the point of death, but for me, it doesn't seem to be too difficult." Jun Xiaoyao thought.
Perhaps it's because he is a soul that has traveled through time, so his soul power is far stronger than that of ordinary people.
This Chaos God's Mill will help him a lot, but it will not cause pain.
"And as your practice deepens, you can directly use your soul power to create the Chaos God's Grind, which can be used as a means to fight against the enemy."
"I can bear that kind of pain, but others probably can't." Jun Xiaoyao sighed.
He seems to have another powerful trump card.
At the same time, over Huangzhou.
A fire sparrow, pulling a gorgeous chariot, fluttered its wings and flew through the void, bringing out a gorgeous tail flame.
This attracts the attention of many people.
"Hey, that chariot has a Suzaku totem on it. It seems to be a chariot from the ancient Suzaku country?"
"That's right, it is rumored that members of the royal family of the ancient Suzaku Kingdom used fire sparrows to pull carts. Could it be the famous princess, Bai Yu'er?"
"Look at the direction it's going, it's the Jun family!"
The arrival of this chariot made many people talk.
Not long after, the chariot stopped outside the Jun family residence.
In the sky over the entire Jun family, except for the Jun family's own people, any other powerful people who dare to pass by rashly will be regarded as an invasion and directly killed.
The chariot door curtain opened, and a beautiful woman with tall figure, slender legs and wearing a red feathered coat stepped out. It was Bai Yu'er.
This time she came alone, without any entourage.
Bai Yu'er looked around and saw that in the Jun family's residence, there were countless divine islands suspended in the void, and various caves and heavens, emitting rays of light.
This shocked Bai Yuer.
Although the Ancient Suzaku Kingdom was also a first-rate force with a far-reaching reputation, it was still dwarfed by the Jun Family of the ancient aristocratic family, and there was not much comparison.
But immediately, Bai Yu'er's lips revealed a hint of confidence and a touch of disdain.
So what if the Jun family is aloof?
That talented person of the Jun family is not yetHe covets her body and wants to give her the elixir of death.
However, Bai Yu'er had already made up her mind and would not hand over her body to the Jun family's genius easily.
After all, she is engaged.
If something happens then, wouldn't it make the eldest prince of the Ancient Qinglong Kingdom's head green?
After thinking about it, Bai Yuer stepped forward.
The entrance to Jun's house is guarded by Jun's imperial guards, who are as towering as iron towers and filled with energy and blood.
"He who comes, stop and tell me your name."
The Jun family guard said in a cold tone.
"I am the princess of the ancient Zhuque Kingdom, Bai Yu'er, and I have come to pay my respects to Jun Linglong." Bai Yu'er said calmly.
"Meet your noble lady? Do you have a token? If not, get out." The Jun family guard said indifferently.
Bai Yuer's pretty face paused.
After all, she was also the princess of a country, and even a guard of the Jun family dared to scold her like this.
However, she came here to ask for something this time, so she could only be patient and took out the jade slip used to communicate with Jun Linglong.
"Go in." The Jun family guard waved his hand indifferently.
Bai Yu'er bit her lip. Her status as a princess seemed so insignificant in front of the Jun family.
On the other side, Jun Linglong also found Jun Xiaoyao.
"Lord Son of God, she is already here." Jun Linglong said.
"Let's go and see this princess."
Jun Xiaoyao stood up. He was dressed in a white shirt and looked handsome. Although he was only eight years old, he was as tall as a boy.
Here, Bai Yuer walked into a fairyland-like courtyard.
Jun Linglong made an appointment to meet her here.
Not long after, Bai Yuer heard footsteps and took a look.
But I saw a young man with a tall figure and skin like fairy jade, walking slowly over.
He seemed to be the son of a god, with a divine appearance and a peerless handsome face, surrounded by a thin layer of light.
Bai Yuer was dumbfounded.
She has seen many of the proudest men of heaven and many young heroes, all of them handsome and charming.
But compared to the young man in front of him, he was like a firefly and a bright moon, or a loach and a real dragon. There was no comparison at all.
Even her fiancé, the eldest prince of the ancient Qinglong Kingdom, was handsome and talented, but compared to the young man in front of him, he still looked dim.
Next to Jun Xiaoyao, Jun Linglong, dressed in palace attire, followed him slowly.
Bai Yuer took a deep breath when she saw this detail.
Jun Linglong is the noble daughter of the Jun family, and she has to please and fawn over her. But now, why does she feel like she has become a maid?
"Where did this genius of the Jun family come from? Could it be that he is a serial number?" Bai Yu'er felt a wave of panic in his heart.
"Are you just worshiping Yu'er?" Jun Xiaoyao asked lightly.
"Exactly." Bai Yu'er bowed slightly, but very reservedly.
She also came to her senses.
No matter how detached the young man in front of her was, he still had some agenda for her.
In this case, there is no need for her to be too humble and lower herself.
"You want to ask for an elixir to save your father?" Jun Xiaoyao continued.
"That's right, I hope the young master will be kind enough to lend a helping hand." Bai Yu'er said calmly, without any hint of humility in his tone.
Jun Xiaoyao raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw this scene.
How do you feel about this attitude...
Not quite right.
It seemed that she didn't come to ask for medicine at all, but came to ask for it as a matter of course.
"Oh? But can you give me a reason? After all, the elixir doesn't fall from the sky." Jun Xiaoyao said in a calm tone.
Bai Yuer's beautiful face paused slightly, and then a touch of sarcasm appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Sure enough, is it for a purpose?
However, it is impossible for Bai Yu'er to exchange the elixir on his own terms.
She said: "Young Master is an extraordinary person. He must have a good status in the Jun family. There should be no shortage of elixir. If you donate a single elixir, you can save a life."
"Not only that, saving my father means saving the lives of hundreds of millions of people in the entire Ancient Suzaku Kingdom."
"For the young master, this is just a little effort, but it can be harvestedAre you not willing to do meritorious deeds and a good reputation? "
Bai Yuer opened her mouth, standing on the moral high ground.
Jun Xiaoyao has the ability to help, why not?
With great ability comes great responsibility, right?
Hearing these somewhat familiar remarks, Jun Xiaoyao actually wanted to laugh.
"It turns out that there will be a day when I am kidnapped by morality? "Jun Xiaoyao was speechless.
